g.aria-label: PIC16F1454 PDIP-14; native functions share pins. Overbar = active low.
* = alternate APFCON location; unstarred paired locations are defaults.
RA0/RA1/RA3 are input-only GPIO; RA0/RA1 also carry bidirectional USB.
RA3 GPIO requires MCLRE=0 and LVP=0. ICSP on RA0/RA1 is legacy LVP only.
VUSB3V3 is the USB regulator pin, not GPIO. No ADC, DAC, comparators or CWG.
